statement.p: Evaluate the integral \int_R 4 xy\,dA, where R is the triangle 5 x + y \le 5,\ x \ge 0,\ y \ge 0.

static.solution:
R, is shown below.
Integrating first over y, we obtain \int_R 4 xy\, dA=\int_0^1 \left( \int_{0}^{5-5 x} 4 xy \,dy \right)\,dx = 4 \int_0^1\frac{xy^2}2\bigg|_0^{5-5 x}\,dx = \int_0^1 2 x(5-5 x)^2\,dx Now integrating with respect to x gives \int_R 4 xy\, dA = \int_0^1 50(x - 2x^2 + x^3)\,dx = 50 \left( \frac{1}{2} x^2 -\frac{2}{3}x^3 + \frac{1}{4} x^4\right) \bigg|_0^1 = \frac{25}{6}.
